integrity: The proof derives the mixed moment from differentiated Dirichlet moments and separately derives both marginal variances. Direct low-dimensional quadrature and a wide finite replay are supplementary. The known asymptotic Greenwood/log-spacings correlation is treated as prior work and recovered as a limit, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas assume ordinary iid uniform spacings, equivalently a symmetric Dirichlet vector with unit parameters.
Higher-order and overlapping spacings are not covered by the finite covariance formula.
An equivalent finite Dirichlet-moment identity may appear in older spacing literature under different notation.
title: Exact finite covariance between Greenwood and Moran spacing tests
